label: Dense positional feature: first original steps and the copy phase
explanation: Dense feature, active on about 55% of all steps. It fires on 100% of t=0 steps, 78% of t=1 and 58% of t=2, then drops to about 25% in the middle and late original phase. It is mostly silent on the <DEL> step (16%) and comes back on about 67% of copy-phase steps (t > L). The predicate (t<=2)|(copy phase) gets dev F1 0.77 and mass recall 0.90, but precision is only 0.71: within these regions, whether it fires depends on the token in a way no simple variable captures. Magnitude: the largest activations are on early copy steps (recall_idx 1-4) that output r, k or p (k 90%, r 85%, p 83% active in copy). Max activations occur when outputting r roughly two to four steps into the copy. Restricting to those outputs is high precision (0.92) but covers only about 10% of the mass. It rarely fires on the delimiter step or on middle original-phase steps. Correctness of copying, digit count and L have little effect.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by phase (copy phase: r, k, p, o; input phase: x, m, h, 1; delimiter step: ) and the token being output, by phase (copy phase: k, r, p, n; delimiter step: k, r, p, o; input phase: -); timing cues that raise it most: t=0, L=8 & t=0, L=7 & t=0.
